Each turn you can Move, take one Action, maybe one Bonus Action, and between turns one Reaction.
Actions
  • Cast a spell (see the Spell Reference pages)

House Rules
  • Catch your breath. Out of combat, spend one Hit Die + your Constitution modifier to heal. Up to 3 times all run; mark each on the Hit Dice track above.
  • Spellcasting. Cast any spell of a type you can cast from a found Spell Book, if you have the slots. You can reach one level above your normal maximum by spending two slots of the level just below it: two level-1 slots cast a level-2 spell, two level-2 slots cast a level-3 spell like Fireball. That over-level cast needs a spellcasting check (DC 10 + the spell's level). The slots are spent whether you pass or fail, and a failure fizzles the spell.

Who You Are

Your Ancestry: Aarakocra

Your ancestry gives you a few natural traits.

Flight. Because of your wings, you have a flying speed equal to your walking speed. You can’t use this flying speed if you’re wearing medium or heavy armor.
Talons. You have talons that you can use to make unarmed strikes. When you hit with them, the strike deals 1d6 + your Strength modifier slashing damage, instead of the bludgeoning damage normal for an unarmed strike.
Wind Caller. Starting at 3rd level, you can cast the gust of wind spell with this trait, without requiring a material component. Once you cast the spell with this trait, you can’t do so again until you finish a long rest.
Your Background: Criminal

You eked out a living in dark alleyways, cutting purses or burgling shops. Perhaps you were part of a small gang of like-minded wrongdoers who looked out for each other.

Trained Skills. Sleight of Hand and Stealth (already on your Skills page).
Tools. Thieves’ Tools.
Origin Feat. Alert (explained under Your Feats).
Your Feats

Feats are special perks from your background and choices, on top of your class.

Alert. Origin Feat. You gain the following benefits. Initiative Proficiency. When you roll Initiative, you can add your Proficiency Bonus to the roll. Initiative Swap. Immediately after you roll Initiative, you can swap your Initiative with the Initiative of one willing ally in the same combat.
Archery. Fighting Style Feat (Prerequisite: Fighting Style Feature). You gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls you make with Ranged weapons.
Weapon Mastery. Your training with weapons allows you to use the mastery properties of three kinds of Simple or Martial weapons of your choice. Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can practice weapon drills and change one of those weapon choices.
Dark Bargain. A pact perk from your backstory. Confirm its exact effect with your DM before play.
Your Class: Fighter (Arcane Archer)

A Master of All Arms and Armor. Fighters all share an unparalleled prowess with weapons and armor, and are well acquainted with death, both meting it out and defying it. Primary Ability: Strength or Dexterity. Hit Point Die: D10. Saves: Strength & Constitution

Who You Are

Deploy Magical Effects Through Enchanted Ammunition. An Arcane Archer studies a unique elven method of archery that weaves magic into attacks to produce supernatural effects.

Track your limited uses here. Each box is one use, and every per-rest use is doubled because this dungeon has no rest.
Second Wind
Bonus Action to regain 1d10 + your Fighter level in Hit Points.
Action Surge
On your turn, take one extra action (anything but the Magic action).
Arcane Shot (Use)
When you make a ranged weapon attack, spend a use to add an Arcane Shot effect.
Second Wind. Bonus Action (Second Wind use). As a Bonus Action, regain 1d10 + your Fighter level in Hit Points. Track uses on your usage boxes above.
Action Surge. Free (Action Surge use). On your turn, take one extra action (anything except the Magic action). Track uses on your usage boxes above.
Tactical Mind. Free (spends a Second Wind). When you fail an ability check, spend a Second Wind use to roll 1d10 and add it to the check, possibly turning the failure into a success. If it still fails, the use isn't spent.
Fighting Style. Passive. You have a Fighting Style feat (see Your Feats) that improves your attacks or defense.
Weapon Mastery. Passive. You can use the mastery property of three kinds of weapons you chose.
Arcane Archer Lore. Passive. You know the Druidcraft or Prestidigitation cantrip (using Intelligence) and gain a skill or tool proficiency.
Arcane Shot. Arcane Shot use. Once per turn, when you make a ranged attack with a Simple or Martial weapon, you can apply one of your Arcane Shot options (listed below). Track uses on your usage boxes above.
Piercing Shot. Arcane Shot option. You make no attack roll. The arrow flies in a line 30 ft long and 1 ft wide; each creature in the line makes a Dexterity save, taking the weapon's damage plus 1d6 piercing on a failure, half on a success.
Bursting Shot. Arcane Shot option. The arrow bursts with force. The target and each creature within 10 ft of it takes 2d6 force damage.

Spell Reference

Cantrips — cast any time, no slot needed
PrestidigitationTransmutation Cantrip
Casting Time: ActionRange: 10 ftComponents: V, SDuration: 1 hour

You create a magical effect within range. Choose the effect from the options below. If you cast this spell multiple times, you can have up to three of its non-instantaneous effects active at a time.

Sensory Effect. You create an instantaneous, harmless sensory effect, such as a shower of sparks, a puff of wind, faint musical notes, or an odd odor.

Fire Play. You instantaneously light or snuff out a candle, a torch, or a small campfire.

Clean or Soil. You instantaneously clean or soil an object no larger than 1 cubic foot.

Minor Sensation. You chill, warm, or flavor up to 1 cubic foot of nonliving material for 1 hour.

Magic Mark. You make a color, a small mark, or a symbol appear on an object or a surface for 1 hour.

Minor Creation. You create a nonmagical trinket or an illusory image that can fit in your hand. It lasts until the end of your next turn. A trinket can deal no damage and has no monetary worth.

Level 2 Spells — each casting spends a slot
Gust of WindLevel 2 Evocationvia race
Casting Time: ActionRange: SelfComponents: V, S, M (a legume seed)Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
ConcentrationSaving throw

A line of strong wind 60 feet long and 10 feet wide blasts from you in a direction you choose for the spell's duration. Each creature that starts its turn in the line must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be pushed 15 feet away from you in a direction following the line.

Any creature in the line must spend 2 feet of movement for every 1 foot it moves when moving closer to you.

The gust disperses gas or vapor, and it extinguishes candles, torches, and similar unprotected flames in the area. It causes protected flames, such as those of lanterns, to dance wildly and has a 50 percent chance to extinguish them.

As a bonus action on each of your turns before the spell ends, you can change the direction in which the line blasts from you.
